thread:
Maya Patel: Quick Q on model/version behavior — if we deprecate a model version (e.g. gptx-3.2-int8) what's the exact behavior for clients that request that pinned version? Are they automatically routed to the next minor, get an error, or served a compatible variant? Need a concise statement for docs + rollback guidance. cc @Jon Reyes @Alex Chen

Jon Reyes: Short answer: we try a compatible fallback when allowed, but for strict pins we return an error. We're standardizing to explicit 410 for deprecated strict pins and adding deprecation headers next deploy.

Alex Chen: Clarify headers + flags: if client includes `X-RI-Pin: strict` -> no fallback, return 410. If `X-RI-Pin: lenient` or absent -> attempt fallback to closest compatible variant. Example headers: 
```
X-RI-Version: gptx-3.2-int8
X-RI-Pin: lenient|strict
```

Maya Patel: OK. So docs need: response codes, header names, curl example, and the recommended migration path. Also timeline so we can notify customers.

Jon Reyes: Timeline: deprecation header + 410-for-strict behavior in next patch (canary Tue), lenient-fallback policy rolled out globally ~one week later. We'll add SDK warning logs in the same window.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2025-09-15T03:00Z (canary 10%).

Sara Liu: For rollback — requirement: canaries + ability to reintroduce old model image within 30m. Eng-sre runbook needs the exact commands. Ping @Priya Nair for infra constraints.

Priya Nair: Confirmed — re-push old image with `ri-deploy --image <tag>`; warmup ≈ 6m. I'll expose a tenant-level knob `force_strict_pinning` and test routes. Also plan to expose `X-RI-Fallback: disabled` for testing the strict path.

Alex Chen: Add server logs for `deprecated_version_requested` and metric `deprecated_pin_requests_total{customer_id}`. That'll help comms and decide extension windows.

Jon Reyes: For customer comms: default deprecation window 90 days from first notice (unless SLA overrides). We'll publish API bulletin + in-console banner and include sample migration steps.

Maya Patel: Can someone draft the one-paragraph we can paste into the API docs and a short changelog blurb? I can write the docs if I get the exact 410 response shape.

Alex Chen: 410 body example to use in docs:
```
{
  "error": "version_deprecated",
  "message": "Requested model version gptx-3.2-int8 is deprecated",
  "deprecated_since": "2025-09-01",
  "suggested_version": "gptx-3.3"
}
```
Also send header `X-RI-Deprecated: true` and `X-RI-Suggested-Version: gptx-3.3`.

Sara Liu: For lenient fallback responses: 200 + headers `X-RI-Fallback-From: gptx-3.2-int8` and `X-RI-Deprecated: true`. We should emit a QA diff event for evaluations so customers can see behavioral changes.

Priya Nair: I'll add infra knobs to force strict mode per tenant for QA. ETA: EOD tomorrow to get a test tenant wired.

Maya Patel: Thanks folks — I'll draft the docs + email. Follow-ups: Jon (merge change + rollout plan), Alex (metrics + response examples), Priya (infra knobs + test tenant), Sara (runbook + rollback steps), Maya (docs + customer comms draft). :thumbsup:
